entities.summary: Michaś Čarot was a Belarusian poet, playwright, and novelist who wrote under the pseudonyms of Maksim Byadneyshi, Jurka Kurtati, and V. Čarot. He was a victim of Stalin's purges and was rehabilitated in 1956 during the Khruschev Thaw.
